name: Jububnan Witchwarper
body:
JUBUBNAN WITCHWARPER
CR 8

XP 4,800
Jububnan witchwarper 9
CN Medium humanoid (jububnan)
Init +7; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +13

DEFENSE

AC 18, touch 13, flat-footed 15 (+3 Dex, +5 armor)
hp 71 (9d8+18+9)
Fort +6, Ref +10, Will +5

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., swim 30 ft.
Melee masterwork dagger +6/+1 (1d4–1 P or S, 19–20/×2)
Ranged laser pistol +9/+4 touch (1d8 fire, range incr. 50 ft., semi-automatic)
Witchwarper Spells Known (CL 9th, concentration +13)

0-level (at will)—acid splash, dancing lights, detect magic, ghost sound (DC 14), 11 mage hand, stumble (DC 14; see page 13)
1st-level (6/day)—enduring worlds, feather fall, puncture veil, shifting surge, swap initiative
2nd-level (5/day)—acid arrow, alter self, hold person (DC 16), slice reality (DC 17; see page 13)
3rd-level (4/day)—fireball (DC 18), fly, probability prediction, slow (DC 17)

STATISTICS

Str 8 (–1); Dex 16 (+3); Con 14 (+2); Int 14 (+2); Wis 8 (–1); Cha 18 (+4)
Base Atk +6; CMB +5; CMD 18 (22 vs. bull rush or trip)
Feats Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Spell Focus (evocation), Spell Penetration, Technologist
Skills Acrobatics +14, Knowledge (arcana, local) +14, Perception +13, Spellcraft +16, Stealth +14, Swim +6
Languages Common, Draconian, Jububnan, Kasatha
SQ alternate outcome (1/day), astonishing balance, compound sight +2 (Perception, Spellcraft), infinite worlds (infinity slots: 1st—6, 2nd—5, 3rd—4), otherworldly skill (Perception), overload reality, paradigm shifts (flash teleport, inhibit, prevent wounds [4d4 hp]), parallel minds, quantum pool (10 points), seek the breach (3/day), puff up (9 min./day), wanderer’s pluck
Gear 2 potions of cure light wounds; Other Gear +1 microcord armor, laser pistol, masterwork dagger, headband of alluring charisma +2, ring of protection +1, 2 silverdisk batteries (10 charges each), credit stick (100 gp)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Astonishing Balance (Ex)

See above.

Puff Up (Ex)

See above.

When using this ability, the jububnan witchwarper’s statistics are: Size Large; AC 17, touch 12, flat-footed 14; Melee masterwork dagger +5/+0 (1d4–1); Ranged laser pistol +8/+3 touch (1d8 fire); Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.; CMB +6; CMD 19 (23 vs. bull rush or trip); Skills Stealth +10.

Wanderer’s Pluck (Ex)

See above.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary, pair, or knot (3–6)
Treasure NPC gear (freebooter armor, synthetic light crossbow with 10 bolts, other treasure)

Jububnans are a species of Galactic wanderers known for their ability to puff up to double their size. They appear much as humanoid toads with large heads, spindly arms, and but a single large leg. Their underlying color is a dark green, but this is overlaid with bright patterns unique to each individual, which can be of any color and are usually quite vivid.

Jububnans are adventurous and independent. Some of them have congregated on various planets, but many of them travel through the Multiverse. All of them tend to be very independent, and jububnan explorers rarely come across another of their species. Luckily for them, they can reproduce via parthenogenesis, allowing them to spawn dozens of eggs at several times during their short lifespans.
